precedence: Adds bounds/Option/loan semantics to existing collection-ownership-sync-v1; does not replace it.

rules.read: Array/List/Vector/Slice.get(index) -> Option<ReadLoan<T>>; Map.get(key) -> Option<ReadLoan<V>>; all loan-bearing Option variants retain owner provenance Borrow permission and root conflict admission precede bounds misses; None never overrides exclusive WRITE authority.
rules.write: get_mut -> Option<WriteLoan<T>> requires unique mutable access; overlap is a static error; write view cannot outlive owner A miss cannot bypass existing loans or immutable access checks.
rules.copy: get_copy -> Option<T> requires Copy<T>; never implicitly copies move-only elements
rules.owned_remove: pop/remove -> Option<T> moves out an owned element after exclusive access and shape update
rules.index: index operator is always range-checked; out-of-range is a contained actor trap; get is the non-panicking default
rules.range: negative and high unsigned indices return None for get without signed wrap; no unchecked 32-bit arithmetic
rules.mutation: resize, insert, erase, compact, sort, reserve-relocate forbidden while any root loan/iterator/view exists (conservative root locking)
rules.suspension: v1 requires no live collection loan across await/select/task suspension or actor-turn completion until pinned continuations and quiescence are proven
rules.escape: loans including Option<ReadLoan<T>>/Result/tuples/closure captures cannot escape via return, channel, shared cell, actor transport, persistence or FFI
rules.move: rt take owner prohibited while loans live; later sender access rejected; actor and generation fenced
rules.sharing: readonly view is not deep freeze or Sync; immutable Share requires transitive Sync/Share proof, without mutable aliases
rules.layout: 32-bit dense index alone is not persistent identity: root allocation, actor, epoch and generation separately verified
rules.option: Some/None explicit, no null sentinel, no automatic Option<Option<T>> flattening
rules.iterator: iterators are rooted READ loans; mutable iterators exclusive; mutation while iterating fails closed
rules.diagnostic: negative fixtures require a semantic ownership/type/bounds diagnostic, not parse-only unsupported feature

reference_model_limitations: source-free alias ledger, not a compile-time borrow checker
no guest values or actual allocation
no optimizer/lowering, lock, lifetime analysis, or native ABI proof
does not authenticate 32-bit handles or model zero-GC
not a substitute for positive and negative compiler guest fixtures
